title: Hands-on Workshop: From Code to Control – Hands-on Embedded System with FreeRTOS
description:
Dear Students,

We are pleased to announce a Hands-on Workshop on "From code to control – Hands-on Embedded System with FreeRTOS".

Explore task creation, scheduling, and synchronization using FreeRTOS through hands-on exercises, and learn how software controls embedded hardware. Through practical implementation, you will gain valuable technical skills that are highly relevant for campus placements, technical interviews, coding assessments, and software development careers.
